task: FV2-027 — Flutter Design V2 audio settings device-first cards and activation controls
summary: The audio settings screen now matches the Web Design V2 information hierarchy: device selection/local check first, then activation, applicable keyboard shortcuts, and processing cards. Existing device selection, local test, PTT/touch, shortcut, and processing state behavior is preserved. Compact layout now moves the full subtitle into a full-width body intro above the first card so it does not truncate in the fixed-height workspace header. Android API 35 and macOS runtime visual acceptance both pass.

checks.name: Test-first widget regressions
checks.observation: New compact Android and desktop tests assert device-first ordering, card surfaces, minimum geometry, 44 px device selectors, activation segment dimensions, and no compact-layout exception. The compact subtitle regression first failed because its paragraph exceeded one line in the fixed header; moving it to a full-width body intro made the regression pass without expanding the shared header or overflowing its row.

checks.name: Focused audio/workspace widget tests
checks.observation: flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart passed all 65 tests, including PTT and existing audio-device/local-check behavior.
